description: Professional service firms including legal (law firms), accounting/tax advisory, and management consulting

common_processes.name: Client Intake & Onboarding
common_processes.description: New client screening, conflict checks, engagement letters, KYC/AML compliance, document collection

common_processes.name: Time Tracking & Billing
common_processes.description: Tracking billable hours, creating invoices, managing WIP, collections

common_processes.name: Document Management & Review
common_processes.description: Creating, reviewing, organizing, and storing client documents

common_processes.name: Research & Analysis
common_processes.description: Legal research, market analysis, due diligence, regulatory review

common_processes.name: Client Communication & Reporting
common_processes.description: Status updates, meeting scheduling, progress reports, client portals

common_processes.name: Business Development & Proposals
common_processes.description: RFP responses, pitches, networking follow-up, CRM management

common_processes.name: Compliance & Risk Management
common_processes.description: Regulatory compliance, risk assessments, audit preparation, policy management

common_processes.name: Knowledge Management & Training
common_processes.description: Capturing institutional knowledge, onboarding new staff, precedent libraries

industry_specific_challenges: Professionals resist time tracking (lost billable hours)
High partner/senior time spent on admin tasks
Clients demanding fee predictability over hourly billing

pain_points.name: Lost Billable Time
pain_points.description: Professionals forget to record all time spent on client work
pain_points.impact: 10-20% of billable time goes unrecorded, costing €50,000-200,000/year per firm
pain_points.ai_potential: AI time capture from calendar/email recovers 10-15% lost revenue

pain_points.name: Partner/Senior Admin Time
pain_points.description: High-value professionals doing low-value admin tasks
pain_points.impact: Partners spend 20-40% of time on admin vs client work
pain_points.ai_potential: AI email drafting, document generation, and scheduling save 5-10 hours/week

pain_points.name: Slow Client Intake Process
pain_points.description: Lengthy intake processes cause prospective clients to go elsewhere
pain_points.impact: 10-20% of potential clients lost to faster competitors
pain_points.ai_potential: Digital intake + automated conflict checks reduce intake time by 80%

pain_points.name: Repetitive Document Drafting
pain_points.description: Time spent on similar documents that could be templated
pain_points.impact: 30-50% of junior time on document work that could be automated
pain_points.ai_potential: AI-assisted drafting creates first versions in minutes vs hours

key_metrics.name: Realization Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of worked hours that get billed and collected
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Better time capture, upfront pricing, automated billing

key_metrics.name: Utilization Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of available hours spent on billable work
key_metrics.benchmark: 70-85% for fee earners, varies by seniority
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Reduce admin tasks, better matter assignment, AI automation

key_metrics.name: Revenue per Professional
key_metrics.description: Annual revenue generated per fee earner
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Increase utilization, reduce write-offs, leverage technology

key_metrics.name: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
key_metrics.description: Average days to collect payment after invoicing
key_metrics.benchmark: 30-45 days is good, >60 days indicates collection issues
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Automated reminders, online payment options, e-billing

key_metrics.name: Client Retention Rate
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Client portals, proactive communication, relationship management
